Vehicle lettering & decals for Vaughan businesses.

Vaughan is one of the busiest trade and logistics hubs in the GTA, and many of the vans, box trucks and trailers we wrap work out of the industrial areas around Highway 7, Highway 400 and Highway 407.

How it works

From first call to finished.

Step 1

Send a photo & logo

A photo of the vehicle and your logo (vector if you have it) is enough for a first layout.

Step 2

Layout on your vehicle

We place the lettering on a to-scale template of your year, make and model and send a proof.

Step 3

Cut or print

Single-colour lettering is cut from cast vinyl; full-colour logos are printed and laminated.

Step 4

Install

Applied in our bay, usually in a few hours — most lettering jobs are same-day.

FAQ

Vehicle lettering & decals questions from Vaughan.

Do you serve Vaughan?
Yes. Our install bay is right here in Vaughan, on Viceroy Road near Highway 7 — most Vaughan customers are less than 15 minutes away. Everything is done at our shop at 50 Viceroy Rd, Unit 22–23, Vaughan, and we serve all of York Region.
How much does vehicle lettering cost in Vaughan?
Lettering and decals usually cost about 22% of a full printed wrap for the same vehicle — for example roughly $620 on a car or $870 on a Transit-size van, before HST. Send a photo and your logo for an exact price.
How long does lettering take?
Once the proof is approved, most lettering installs take a few hours and many are done the same day.
Will decals damage my paint?
No. Quality cast vinyl removes cleanly from factory (OEM) paint when it is taken off properly.
Can you add DOT or unit numbers?
Yes — unit numbers and regulatory text can be added as part of the layout. You are responsible for confirming which numbers your vehicle class needs.
